newsitem.title: USA: Sparta registers to sell 2 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Sparta registers to sell 2 mln shrs.

text.p: Sparta Pharmaceuticals Inc said Wednesay it has filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on Form S-3 registering, on behalf of certain shareholders, 2,035,000 shares of its common stock for resale.
This registration statement covers two million shares of common stock previously issued in connection with the acquisition of the business and assets of Lexin Pharmaceutical Corp in March 1996.
The company said there are resale restrictions on the shares used in connection with that acquisition.
